<script>
(function(){
  const cont = document.getElementById('quiz');
  const scoreEl = document.getElementById('score');
  let done = 0, ok = 0;
  function render(){
    cont.innerHTML = ''; done = 0; ok = 0; scoreEl.textContent = '';
    QS.forEach((item, qi) => {
      const card = document.createElement('div'); card.className = 'qz-card';
      const q = document.createElement('div'); q.className = 'qz-q'; q.textContent = item.q; card.appendChild(q);
      const exp = document.createElement('div'); exp.className = 'qz-exp';
      item.o.forEach((opt, oi) => {
        const b = document.createElement('button'); b.className = 'qz-opt'; b.textContent = opt;
        b.onclick = () => {
          card.querySelectorAll('.qz-opt').forEach((x, xi) => {
            x.classList.add('disabled');
            if (xi === item.a) x.classList.add('ok');
          });
          if (oi !== item.a) b.classList.add('bad'); else ok++;
          exp.style.display = 'block';
          exp.innerHTML = (oi === item.a ? '<strong>Correcto.</strong> ' : '<strong>La correcta es ' + item.o[item.a].slice(0,2) + '.</strong> ') + item.e;
          done++;
          scoreEl.textContent = 'Respondidas: ' + done + ' / ' + QS.length + ' — Correctas: ' + ok;
          if (done === QS.length) scoreEl.textContent += (ok >= 8 ? ' · ¡Muy bien!' : ' · Revisa las explicaciones de las que fallaste.');
        };
        card.appendChild(b);
      });
      card.appendChild(exp);
      cont.appendChild(card);
    });
  }
  document.getElementById('reset').onclick = render;
  render();
})();
</script>
